notes.id: Madrasah Tsanawiyah (setara SMP), YKPI Al-Ittihad. Biaya bertingkat menurut penghasilan orang tua: Grade A (> Rp10 jt/bulan) UP Rp11.600.000, SPP Rp1.200.000; Grade B (Rp6–10 jt) UP Rp9.100.000, SPP Rp850.000; Grade C (< Rp6 jt) UP Rp6.000.000, SPP Rp600.000. Alumni: UP lebih rendah Rp500.000–Rp1.000.000.
notes.en: Madrasah Tsanawiyah (SMP-equivalent), YKPI Al-Ittihad. Fees tiered by parents' income: Grade A (> Rp10M/month) entry Rp11,600,000, tuition Rp1,200,000; Grade B (Rp6–10M) Rp9,100,000, Rp850,000; Grade C (< Rp6M) Rp6,000,000, Rp600,000. Alumni pay Rp500,000–Rp1,000,000 less.
